control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at P-3221

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-3221, M-3221 and PT-3221 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 March 2018 a potential incident was recorded on P-3221, M-3221 and PT-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
